passages.note: The NLM exhibition reports that David Nalin shared findings with the Johns Hopkins team in Calcutta in summer 1968; it later describes Mahalanabis organizing teams at Bongaon in 1971. This documented exchange provides context, not proof that a single person or meeting caused the 1971 deployment.
